targets.old_statement: Lincoln crown hidden by tread passes the penny test, while a fully visible head fails it and orders new tires.
targets.old_spoken_statement: Lincoln crown hidden by tread passes the penny test, while a fully visible head fails it and orders new tires.
targets.statement: In the penny test, having any part of Lincoln's head covered by tread shows safe tread depth, whereas tread below that mark means road grip in adverse conditions is sharply reduced.
